Read-only readback on the deployed acceptance database shows 0 rows for all 13 models, so the defect is latent there and no runtime effect has been observed; two of them (project.boq.analysis.norm.line, project.boq.analysis.resource.line) are the declared source_bounded authority for their models, which is why they cannot be left inferred.
